title: Wordfold original Spanish catalog pilot
notice: Original pilot content for validating the multilingual catalog pipeline. It is not production content and is excluded from normal catalog APIs until independent Spanish and Slovak review is recorded.

editorialReferences.use: Authorized reference framework for developing, organizing, and classifying original Spanish-learning content across A1-C2 in a commercial application; no protected PCIC learner-facing text is copied or bundled.
editorialReferences.attribution: Spanish learning content structured according to the Plan Curricular del Instituto Cervantes (PCIC), A1-C2.
editorialReferences.endorsementStatus: No certification, accreditation, endorsement, or official validation is claimed.
